win support: To win support from young voters, the mayor promised to build more parks and cheaper apartments.
為了贏得年輕選民的支持，市長承諾要興建更多公園和更便宜的公寓。
win respect: You cannot win respect by shouting at people; you earn it by being honest and kind.
你無法靠對人吼叫贏得尊敬；你要靠誠實和善良來贏得它。
win over the audience: The nervous speaker told a funny story at the beginning to win over the audience quickly.
那位緊張的講者在開頭說了一個好笑的故事，想快速贏得觀眾的心。
win the day: The other team was stronger, but we believed that teamwork and hard work would win the day.
對手隊伍比較強，但我們相信團隊合作和努力最終會獲勝。
win hands down: Our school's band played so well that everyone knew it would win hands down in the music contest.
我們學校的樂隊表現太好了，大家都知道它會在音樂比賽中輕鬆獲勝。
win back trust: After lying to his parents, Tom worked hard for months to win back trust from them.
對父母說謊後，湯姆努力了好幾個月，想重獲他們的信任。
win someone's heart: He tried to win her heart by writing her a love letter and cooking her favorite dinner.
他寫情書並煮她最愛吃的晚餐，想贏得她的芳心。
win-win: Selling old books to younger students is a win-win: we get money, and they get cheap books.
把舊書賣給學弟妹是雙贏：我們拿到錢，他們買到便宜的書。
wind up in jail: If he keeps stealing cars and running from the police, he will wind up in jail one day.
如果他繼續偷車又躲警察，總有一天他最後會進監獄。
wind down: After a long day at school, I like to wind down by reading a novel and drinking hot tea.
在學校度過漫長的一天後，我喜歡讀小說、喝熱茶來放鬆。
wind up a business: After running the shop for thirty years, the old couple decided to wind up a business that no longer made money.
經營這家店三十年後，這對老夫婦決定結束這個已不再賺錢的生意。
wind someone up: My little brother loves to wind me up by hiding my phone right before I leave for school.
我弟弟很愛在我出門上學前把我的手機藏起來惹惱我。
wind one's way: The hikers had to wind their way slowly along the narrow mountain path to reach the lake.
登山客必須沿著狹窄的山路慢慢蜿蜒前行，才能到達湖邊。
wind a clock: Every Sunday night, my grandfather has to wind a clock in the living room so that it keeps ticking all week.
每個星期天晚上，我爺爺都要替客廳的時鐘上發條，讓它整週持續滴答作響。
get wind of: If the teachers get wind of our plan to skip class, we will be in big trouble.
如果老師聽到我們打算翹課的風聲，我們就麻煩大了。
wink at wrongdoing: Some officials were paid to wink at wrongdoing, pretending they saw nothing illegal at the factory.
有些官員收錢對不法行為睜一隻眼閉一隻眼，假裝沒看到工廠裡任何違法的事。
wink at someone: Across the dinner table, Grandpa would wink at me, closing one eye to show our secret was safe.
爺爺會在餐桌對面對我眨眼，閉上一隻眼睛表示我們的秘密很安全。
not sleep a wink: The night before the big exam, I was so nervous that I did not sleep a wink.
大考前一晚，我緊張到一夜未眠。
in the wink of an eye: The magician waved his hand, and in the wink of an eye, the rabbit disappeared from the hat.
魔術師揮了揮手，一眨眼間，兔子就從帽子裡消失了。
wipe out a species: Scientists warn that cutting down the rainforest could wipe out a species before we even discover it.
科學家警告，砍伐雨林可能在我們發現某個物種之前就使它滅絕。
wipe out debt: She took a second job and saved every dollar, hoping to wipe out debt from her student loans in three years.
她兼了第二份工作並存下每一塊錢，希望三年內把學貸債務一筆勾銷。
wipe the slate clean: After their big fight, the two friends agreed to wipe the slate clean and start their friendship again.
大吵一架後，這兩個朋友同意既往不咎，重新開始他們的友誼。
wipe the smile off one's face: He was laughing at my old shoes, but my high test score soon wiped the smile off his face.
他原本在嘲笑我的舊鞋，但我的高分很快就讓他笑不出來了。
wipe out savings: The expensive hospital bills nearly wiped out savings that the family had kept for twenty years.
昂貴的醫藥費幾乎耗盡了這家人存了二十年的積蓄。
wipe away tears: The little girl tried to wipe away tears with her sleeve after she lost her favorite toy.
弄丟最喜歡的玩具後，小女孩試著用袖子拭去眼淚。
wipe the floor with: Our basketball team practiced every day, so we were able to wipe the floor with them in the final.
我們籃球隊每天練習，所以在決賽中徹底打敗了他們。
wire money: My uncle works in Japan and wires money to his family in Taiwan at the end of every month.
我叔叔在日本工作，每個月底都會電匯錢給他在台灣的家人。
wire a house: Before we moved in, we hired an electrician to wire a house so that every room would have lights and outlets.
搬進去之前，我們請了電工為房子配線，讓每個房間都有電燈和插座。
be wired differently: Some kids are wired differently; they learn much better by moving and touching things than by sitting still.
有些孩子天生不同；比起靜靜坐著，他們透過動手和觸摸東西學得更好。
be wired: After drinking three cups of coffee, I was wired and could not fall asleep until three in the morning.
喝了三杯咖啡後，我精神亢奮，一直到凌晨三點才睡著。
down to the wire: The game went down to the wire, and our team scored the winning point in the final second.
這場比賽一直拚到最後一刻，我們隊在最後一秒得到致勝的一分。
